description: Hierarchical chess puzzle theme taxonomy for progressive learning

themes.name: Fork
themes.description: Simultaneous attack on two or more pieces

subthemes.name: Knight Fork
subthemes.description: Fork using knight's L-shaped movement

subthemes.name: King+Rook Knight Fork
subthemes.description: Knight forks king and rook, winning the rook

subthemes.name: f7 Knight Fork
subthemes.description: Classic knight fork on f7 attacking king on e8 and rook on h8

subthemes.name: c7 Knight Fork
subthemes.description: Knight fork on c7 attacking king and rook on queenside

subthemes.name: King+Queen Knight Fork
subthemes.description: Knight forks king and queen, winning the queen

subthemes.name: Queen+Rook Knight Fork
subthemes.description: Knight forks queen and rook, winning material

subthemes.name: Bishop Fork
subthemes.description: Fork using bishop's diagonal movement

subthemes.name: Rook+Knight Bishop Fork
subthemes.description: Bishop forks rook and knight on same diagonal

subthemes.name: Queen Fork
subthemes.description: Fork using queen's versatile movement

subthemes.name: King+Rook Queen Fork
subthemes.description: Queen forks king and rook

subthemes.name: Pawn Fork
subthemes.description: Fork using pawn's capture pattern

themes.name: Pin
themes.description: Piece cannot move without exposing a more valuable piece

subthemes.name: Absolute Pin
subthemes.description: Pinned piece cannot legally move (pinned to king)

subthemes.name: Bishop Absolute Pin
subthemes.description: Bishop pins piece to king on diagonal

subthemes.name: Rook Absolute Pin
subthemes.description: Rook pins piece to king on file or rank

subthemes.name: Queen Absolute Pin
subthemes.description: Queen pins piece to king

subthemes.name: Relative Pin
subthemes.description: Pinned piece can legally move but would lose material

subthemes.name: Bishop Relative Pin
subthemes.description: Bishop pins piece to queen or rook

subthemes.name: Rook Relative Pin
subthemes.description: Rook pins piece to queen

themes.name: Skewer
themes.description: Reverse pin - valuable piece must move, exposing less valuable piece

subthemes.name: King+Rook Skewer
subthemes.description: King must move, exposing rook behind it

subthemes.name: Queen+Rook Skewer
subthemes.description: Queen must move, exposing rook behind it

themes.name: Discovered Attack
themes.description: Moving one piece reveals attack from another piece

subthemes.name: Discovered Check
subthemes.description: Moving piece reveals check on opponent's king

subthemes.name: Discovered Check with Capture
subthemes.description: Moving piece captures while revealing check

subthemes.name: Discovered Attack on Queen
subthemes.description: Moving piece reveals attack on opponent's queen

themes.name: Double Attack
themes.description: Two separate threats in one move

subthemes.name: Check and Attack
subthemes.description: Give check while attacking another piece

subthemes.name: Double Check
subthemes.description: Two pieces give check simultaneously (king must move)

themes.name: Sacrifice
themes.description: Voluntarily giving up material for advantage

subthemes.name: Queen Sacrifice
subthemes.description: Sacrificing the queen for checkmate or winning advantage

subthemes.name: Queen Sacrifice for Checkmate
subthemes.description: Queen sacrifice leading directly to checkmate

subthemes.name: Queen Sacrifice for Attack
subthemes.description: Queen sacrifice for unstoppable attack

subthemes.name: Rook Sacrifice
subthemes.description: Sacrificing rook for tactical advantage

subthemes.name: Minor Piece Sacrifice
subthemes.description: Sacrificing bishop or knight

subthemes.name: Exchange Sacrifice
subthemes.description: Giving up rook for minor piece (3 points)

themes.name: Hanging Piece
themes.description: Undefended or insufficiently defended piece free to capture

themes.name: Exposed King
themes.description: King with few defenders, vulnerable to attack

subthemes.name: Attacking f2/f7
subthemes.description: Attack focusing on the weak f2 or f7 pawn

themes.name: Attraction
themes.description: Exchange or sacrifice forcing opponent piece to a vulnerable square

themes.name: Deflection
themes.description: Forcing piece away from important square or duty

subthemes.name: Deflection from Defense
subthemes.description: Deflecting defender away from protected piece

subthemes.name: Deflection from Key Square
subthemes.description: Forcing piece away from controlling key square

themes.name: Removal of Defender
themes.description: Capturing or deflecting piece that defends target

subthemes.name: Capture Defender
subthemes.description: Directly capturing the defending piece

subthemes.name: Deflect Defender
subthemes.description: Forcing defender to move away

themes.name: Trapped Piece
themes.description: Piece has no safe squares to move to

subthemes.name: Trapped Queen
subthemes.description: Queen has no escape squares

subthemes.name: Trapped Rook
subthemes.description: Rook has no escape squares

subthemes.name: Trapped Bishop
subthemes.description: Bishop trapped by pawns or pieces

subthemes.name: Bishop Trapped on a7/h7
subthemes.description: Classic trapped bishop on a7/h7 after capturing b2/g2 pawn

subthemes.name: Trapped Knight
subthemes.description: Knight trapped with no escape squares

subthemes.name: Knight Trapped on Edge
subthemes.description: Knight on edge of board with limited mobility

themes.name: Pawn Tactics
themes.description: Tactics involving pawn moves and pawn structure

subthemes.name: Advanced Pawn
subthemes.description: Pawn deep in opponent position, threatening promotion

subthemes.name: Promotion
subthemes.description: Promoting a pawn to queen or minor piece

subthemes.name: Underpromotion
subthemes.description: Promoting to knight, bishop, or rook instead of queen

subthemes.name: En Passant
subthemes.description: Capturing a pawn that bypassed using its initial two-square move

themes.name: Defensive Move
themes.description: Precise move needed to avoid losing material or another advantage

themes.name: Attacking Patterns
themes.description: Strategic attacking themes

subthemes.name: Kingside Attack
subthemes.description: Attack on opponent's king castled on the kingside

subthemes.name: Queenside Attack
subthemes.description: Attack on opponent's king castled on the queenside

subthemes.name: Castling
subthemes.description: Bringing king to safety and deploying rook for attack

subthemes.name: Collinear Move
subthemes.description: Sliding along line of attack without capturing the enemy piece

themes.name: Back Rank
themes.description: Checkmate or threat on opponent's back rank

subthemes.name: Back Rank Mate
subthemes.description: Checkmate on back rank with king trapped by own pawns

subthemes.name: Back Rank Weakness
subthemes.description: Exploiting weak back rank for advantage

themes.name: Mating Attack
themes.description: Direct checkmate or unstoppable mating attack

subthemes.name: Mate in 1
subthemes.description: Checkmate in one move

subthemes.name: Mate in 2
subthemes.description: Forced checkmate in two moves

subthemes.name: Mate in 3
subthemes.description: Forced checkmate in three moves

subthemes.name: Smothered Mate
subthemes.description: Knight checkmate with king blocked by own pieces

subthemes.name: Anastasia's Mate
subthemes.description: Knight and rook checkmate pattern

subthemes.name: Arabian Mate
subthemes.description: Knight and rook mate on edge of board

subthemes.name: Dovetail Mate
subthemes.description: Queen checkmate with king trapped by own pieces in 'v' shape

subthemes.name: Mate in 4
subthemes.description: Forced checkmate in four moves

subthemes.name: Mate in 5+
subthemes.description: Forced checkmate in five or more moves

subthemes.name: Boden's Mate
subthemes.description: Two bishops on criss-crossing diagonals deliver mate

subthemes.name: Corner Mate
subthemes.description: Rook or queen and knight confine king to corner

subthemes.name: Double Bishop Mate
subthemes.description: Two bishops on adjacent diagonals deliver mate

subthemes.name: Epaulette Mate
subthemes.description: Two adjacent escape squares occupied by own pieces

subthemes.name: Hook Mate
subthemes.description: Rook, knight, and pawn with enemy pawn limiting escape

subthemes.name: Kill Box Mate

subthemes.name: Morphy's Mate
subthemes.description: Bishop checks king while rook confines it

subthemes.name: Opera Mate
subthemes.description: Rook checks king with bishop defending the rook

subthemes.name: Pillsbury's Mate
subthemes.description: Rook delivers mate while bishop helps confine king

subthemes.name: Swallow's Tail Mate
subthemes.description: V-shaped checkmate pattern

subthemes.name: Triangle Mate
subthemes.description: Queen and rook form triangle pattern near enemy king

subthemes.name: Vuković Mate
subthemes.description: Rook and knight team up, rook supported by third piece

subthemes.name: Balestra Mate
subthemes.description: Bishop delivers mate while queen blocks escape squares

subthemes.name: Blind Swine Mate
subthemes.description: Two rooks mate king in 2x2 square area

themes.description: Endgame techniques and patterns

subthemes.name: Pawn Endgame
subthemes.description: King and pawn endgame technique

subthemes.name: Opposition
subthemes.description: King opposition in pawn endgames

subthemes.name: Triangulation
subthemes.description: King triangulation to lose tempo

subthemes.name: Rook Endgame
subthemes.description: Rook endgame technique

subthemes.description: Winning rook and pawn endgame position

subthemes.description: Drawing rook and pawn endgame position

subthemes.name: Bishop Endgame
subthemes.description: Endgame with only bishops and pawns

subthemes.name: Knight Endgame
subthemes.description: Endgame with only knights and pawns

subthemes.description: Queen endgame technique

subthemes.description: Endgame with queens, rooks, and pawns

themes.description: Attack through another piece
